mainEntity.name: How quickly should a gym follow up a lead?

acceptedAnswer.text: As soon as you reasonably can, ideally the same day. If you can't reply properly straight away, send a short holding reply from a person and then follow through. What matters most is that every enquiry gets a reply and a follow-up if they go quiet.

mainEntity.name: How many times should I follow up a gym enquiry?

acceptedAnswer.text: For most enquiries, three messages over about a week is enough: the first reply, a short nudge the next day and a helpful last message at the end of the week. Then stop, and stop straight away if anyone says no thanks.

mainEntity.name: What should a gym's first reply to an enquiry say?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use their name and yours, answer the question they asked, ask one easy question and offer one clear next step, such as a visit or a taster session. Keep it short and easy to answer.

mainEntity.name: Who should follow up leads in a small gym?

acceptedAnswer.text: One named person each day, not the whole team. Give them a single list of open enquiries from every channel, a clear status for each one and a few minutes every morning to clear it.

mainEntity.name: Can follow-up for gym leads be automated?

acceptedAnswer.text: The repeatable parts can, like logging enquiries from your web form and email in one place, sending the next follow-up when someone hasn't replied and stopping when they do. Conversations and real questions should stay with a person. Omnirexis sets up follow-ups for enquiries by phone, web form or email around the tools you already use.
